title: 'I live for these moments': Daniels again delivers in clutch for Commanders

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: 'I live for these moments': Daniels again delivers in clutch for Commanders
sources.description: After failing multiple times in late-game situations earlier this season, Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels put together a second consecutive winning drive Monday night as Washington kicked a last-second field goal to beat Cincinnati 22-20.
